lead_updates.title: Letter in cipher addressed to Cornelius K. Bettman, Barcelona, with a map thought to be of Havana harbour
lead_updates.status: Card read 2 Nov 2026: file P.F. 1444 runs 1 Apr 1918 to 17 Mar 1919 with no decipherment recorded; later items are a Havana harbour sketch and defences blueprint (7 May 1918) and the addressee not found at Pino 5, Barcelona (21 June 1918).

703.unvetted: The cipher message itself was not located: frame check 06 shows the Weiskopf letter (M1085 roll 307 frame 2026) and frames 2024-2030 carry no cipher text; the copy should be in the Nogales report elsewhere on OG 3337. Needs a scan of the rest of roll 307 OG 3337 (access is not 'archive', so 'not online' is not accepted).

seen.where: NARA RG 242 T405 roll 9 (NAID 332033680) frames 350 (key card), 862 (clear Fernschreiben) and 863 (five-part Funkspruch), .tif images fetched by curl from the catalog medialz route and viewed 2 Nov 2026
seen.extent: c. 70 Funkspruch forms (1940), mostly multi-part; one 1939 exercise message with key card.
seen.cipher: Frame 863: a Funkspruch form, handwritten five-letter groups in columns, 'An 1. Tl - 179' ('5 Tle'), no plaintext or key on it. Frame 350: typed key card 'Annahme: Luftgauschluessel fuer den 25.2.1939', two transposition keys a=21 and b=19, Kenngruppen qli vzn fks puc. Frame 862 (4 June 1940, Fernschreiben of Flugabwehrkommando Schwarzwald Ic to Luftgaukommando VII, Geheime Kommandosache) is a typed clear text on Flak movements, not attached to a decipherment of any Funkspruch. No decipherment is written on the 1940 leaves.

prior_art.decode: Not on DECODE (a US NARA Luftwaffe film, not a European archive record); known.py 'Schwarzwald'/'T405' hits only this entry.

prior_art.lasry: No Lasry treatment found; searches for Luftgauschluessel/T405 found only general double-transposition literature (Wambach; cryptocellar Truppenschluessel paper).
prior_art.edition: CRL catalogue lists T405 ('German Air Force records: Luftgaukommandos, Flak, Deutsche Luftwaffenmission in Rumaenien', AHA 1959) with no content-level edition of roll 9; no publication of these messages.
prior_art.literature: WebSearch (3 queries 2 Nov 2026: T405 roll 9 Schwarzwald; Luftgauschluessel double transposition Kenngruppe; Luftgauschluessel Doppelwuerfel Flak 1940): no source on the Luftgau key system or on these messages.

704.key_check: The only key held is the 25.2.1939 card (frame 350), which reads the 1939 exercise message and is useless for 1940 (keys change daily). Not applied to 1940. A candidate crib is the clear Fernschreiben on frame 862 of 4 June 1940, whose text may be the plaintext of an enciphered Funkspruch on the neighbouring frames; not tested here.

lead_updates.status: Viewed 2 Nov 2026: frame 863 ciphertext is clean handwriting in five-letter groups; frame 862 holds a clear typed Fernschreiben of 4 June 1940 that is a possible crib for the double transposition of the 1940 Funksprueche.

708.unvetted: No evidence of cipher content: NARA's series description (RG 216 'Secret Submissions', naId 1266133; the Guide to Federal Records lists 'submissions concerning intercepted communications of a suspicious nature (X submissions), 1942-45, 4 rolls') concerns secret writing and concealed messages, and the series is not digitised, so no cipher item is identified. Needs a reel-level look at the film (College Park) before it can be a lead.
